interface.signature: status: List[int], candies: List[int], keys: List[List[int]], containedBoxes: List[List[int]], initialBoxes: List[int] -> int

preconditions.description: The length of status must be between 1 and 1000.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= s <= 1 for s in status)
preconditions.description: Each element in status must be either 0 or 1.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= c <= 1000 for c in candies)
preconditions.description: Each element in candies must be between 1 and 1000.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= k < len(status) for k in sum(keys, []))
preconditions.description: All keys must be valid indices within the range of status.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= b < len(status) for b in sum(containedBoxes, []))
preconditions.description: All contained boxes must be valid indices within the range of status.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= i < len(status) for i in initialBoxes)
preconditions.description: All initial boxes must be valid indices within the range of status.

postconditions.expression: stdout == sum(candies[i] for i in range(len(status)) if i in reachable_boxes)
postconditions.description: The output must be the sum of candies in all reachable boxes.
